_comment: 极速模拟 strategy (autostronghold/tactics/sp3/fast.py). Derived on the Stronghold-Protocol simulator (SP3, act3autochess@V3_1);
evidence: docs/SP3-无模型策略-证据与评测.md, sweeps sw1-sw7. Edit <program folder>/tactics/sp3_fast.json to override.
level_plan: shop level wanted from that round on (FAST prices 1/1/5/8/10). min_field: operators fielded before levelling.
tier_power / elite_mul: strength of an operator by tier, x elite_mul once three copies merged.
bond_weights: value per threshold reached (精准 at 3 distinct also buffs every ranged operator); others: season_weight / other_weight.
medic_weight 0: a medic is valued only by its tier and traits (+10.6 win points in sw1). melee_min / melee_weight: blockers on the route.
merge_share: share of the elite gain counted for a copy when 1 / 2 are owned. buy_min / replace_margin: least gain to buy / to push out.
refresh_budget: refreshes per round once the planned level is reached (leader round: unlimited, the bench is sold first).
